watch_list.short_title: How well last year’s post aged
watch_list.summary: She rereads last year’s note that senior engineers must build guardrails and still decide what ships even if AIs write most of the code, and asks what you’ll predict a year from now.
He turned on HTML-in-Canvas in Claude’s desktop apps so Claude can make strange Flash-era-style sites, and posted demos at https://claude.ai/artifact/7cCNqKnoFSoib9SuNLB3vk
Replying to Ethan Mollick’s Fable and Opus Starship-catch render, he says to measure video-to-render pixel error and drive it under 10 in 255 for a closer match.

items.title: Can You Tell Which Shot Is AI? | Seedance 2.5 4K
items.summary: A 50-second short compares Seedance 2.5’s new native 4K output with real footage and announces the model is live on Higgsfield, plus a Black Friday discount of up to 60% off.
